title: 序章9 新的一天序章10 精气与冲动
content_zh:
而随着人口的增加。
提里斯的奴隶已经满足不了他们的发展的需要，于是他们就开始发展奴隶贸易。
马文过于强大、又过于遥远，他们惹不起。
好在，临近的“边境之森”
里，有大量的异族，不光天赋各异，数量还不少。
原本应该很顺利的。
可好景不长。
随着对边境之森的开发，马尔提雅人才终于意识到了大自然的恐怖。
越是森林深处，环境越是恶劣，异族实力越是强大。
奴隶贸易发展受挫的马尔提雅并没有因此就停下发展的脚步。
他们很聪明，立刻转变了“寄生策略”
开始学习马文的冒险者制度，大力发展冒险者公会。
实力差的异族，继续作为奴隶交易；实力强的异族，就借助公会榨取价值。
时光荏苒。
如今的马尔提雅，更加壮大了。
也正式登上了国家级舞台。
大大小小的国家星罗棋布，今日灭亡，明天新建，根本没有一个确切的数字。
但他们大部分都有一个共同点，各个都对周围虎视眈眈。
马尔提雅想要继续活下去、继续发展下去，不可避免的就要寄生强大的马文。
于是，与隔壁马文的“交锋”

开始了。
可惜的是，马文作为历史悠久的国家。
无论国力、文化、还是技术，都全方面碾压马尔提雅。
马尔提雅多次行动，全部以失败告终。
要不是距离太远，马尔提雅资产尚且不足以吸引马文动手，这样的发展策略，恐怕早就被马文灭国了。
蛰伏后的马尔提雅，开始焦虑，开始不满足于现状。
马文的压力，让他们被迫加快脚步；实力的膨胀，让他们更瞧不起异族。
更快地异族“商品化”
进程，刻不容缓。
这样的背景下，便有了先前的“激进派”
“保守派”
，便有了大量新政策的出台，便有了如今的黑蔷薇监狱...
所以，现在市面上的大多数异族，都是来自边境之森的。
边境之森，面积堪比十数个亚欧大陆。
广袤的森林面积，孕育出了庞大且复杂的族群与生态体系。
马尔提雅人，根据生存与开发难度。
将边境之森划分为9圈，圈数越高越危险。
content_en:
And with the increase in population.
The slaves of Tiris could no longer meet their development needs, so they began to develop the slave trade.
Marvin was too powerful and too distant for them to mess with.
Fortunately, the nearby "Border Forest"
There are a large number of alien races here, not only with different talents, but also in large numbers.
It should have gone smoothly.
But the good times didn't last long.
With the development of the border forest, the Martian talents finally realized the horror of nature.
The deeper into the forest, the harsher the environment, and the stronger the alien race becomes.
Martiya, whose development of the slave trade was frustrated, did not stop its development.
They were very smart and immediately changed their "parasitic strategy"
Start learning from Marvin's adventurer system and vigorously develop the adventurer guild.
Foreign races with weak strength continue to be traded as slaves; foreign races with strong strength use guilds to extract value.
Time flies.
Today, Martiya is even stronger.
It has also officially entered the national stage.
Countries, large and small, are scattered all over the place. They are destroyed today and will be built tomorrow. There is no exact number at all.
But most of them have one thing in common, they all look covetously at their surroundings.
If Martia wants to continue to live and develop, it will inevitably have to parasitize the powerful Marvin.
So, the "confrontation" with Marvin next door
It started.
It's a pity that Marvin is a country with a long history.
Regardless of national strength, culture, or technology, they crush Martiya in all aspects.
Martiya made many attempts, but all ended in failure.
If it weren't for the distance, Martiya's assets wouldn't be enough to attract Marvin. Such a development strategy might have destroyed the country long ago.
After hibernation, Martiya began to become anxious and dissatisfied with the status quo.
Marvin's pressure forced them to speed up their pace; their expansion in strength made them look down on the foreign races even more.
Faster “commodification” of interracial races
The process is urgent.
In this context, there were previous "radicals"
"conservative"
, a large number of new policies were introduced, and today's Black Rose Prison...
Therefore, most of the alien races on the market now come from the Border Forest.
The border forest is comparable in area to more than a dozen Eurasian continents.
The vast forest area has given birth to a large and complex ethnic group and ecological system.
Marthians, based on survival and development difficulty.
The border forest is divided into 9 circles. The higher the number of circles, the more dangerous it is.
